facts.text: The hotel has an 800-metre stretch of beach with sea views toward the city of Split and the surrounding islands.
facts.excerpt: Split beach hotel boasts an 800 m stretch of beach and fantastic sea views toward the city and surrounding islands.

facts.text: The hotel is in Podstrana, on the coast just outside Split, Croatia.
facts.excerpt: Grljevacka, 2A, Podstrana, Split, Croatia, 21312

facts.text: Every guest room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a large balcony.
facts.excerpt: Each of the 379 guestrooms and suites features floor-to-ceiling windows opening to large balconies

facts.text: The Terrace Suite has a large terrace with a private Jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: Indulge the pleasure of staying in an exclusive suite with 143 sqm of indoor space and a magnificent terrace with the private Jacuzzi.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a private balcony with a panoramic view of the Adriatic Sea and nearby islands.
facts.excerpt: Experience the glamorous panoramic view of the Adriatic Sea and nearby islands from the private balcony offering a 90 ° view.

facts.text: The RE:CUPERA spa has steam baths and saunas, treatment rooms, an indoor pool and a fitness area.
facts.excerpt: It has numerous steam baths and saunas, exclusive beauty treatments, modern treatment rooms, indoor pool, state of the art fitness and various other services.

facts.text: The spa offers Asian massage styles including Thai, Balinese, Lomi-Lomi, reflexology, shiatsu and Ayurveda.
facts.excerpt: Choose from a variety of options, including Thai massage, Balinese massage, Lomi-Lomi, Reflexology, Shiatsu, and Ayurveda.

facts.text: The spa offers a hammam ritual with a full body and face treatment.
facts.excerpt: Hammam with a complete body and face treatment that ends up with the Cleopatra

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Sip on carefully crafted cocktails and enjoy all shades of blue at our infinity pool.

facts.text: The fitness centre overlooks the Adriatic Sea.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy high-end fitness facility overlooking the Adriatic Sea at our Split hotel with a pool.

facts.text: The hotel's tennis courts are right by the sea.
facts.excerpt: Our tennis courts are located right by the sea.

facts.text: There are four tennis courts with lights and a hardcourt surface of the kind used on the ATP Tour.
facts.excerpt: Four tennis courts with lights and brand-new hardcourt surface (professional surface used on the ATP Tour)

facts.text: The hotel has its own marina, where guests can book a berth.
facts.excerpt: Book a berth in a beautiful Mediterranean marina located in the very centre of the Croatian coast.

facts.text: The hotel's yacht, the Lav Boat, takes guests on tours of the Adriatic coast and nearby islands from the hotel marina.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a coastal journey with our stylish yacht and experience pristine nature of the Adriatic Sea and nearby islands. A premium boat for exclusive tours awaits in our marina.

facts.text: The Thrills & Chills adventure agency arranges excursions such as boat tours to nearby islands, national park outings, cliff jumping and canyoning.
facts.excerpt: Whether you're seeking boat tours to nearby islands, family-friendly outings in national parks, cliff jumping, or extreme canyoning, our experts can curate the perfect adventure to suit your interests.

facts.text: Breakfast at Spalatum Restaurant is a buffet, served inside or on a terrace with views of the Adriatic Sea and the city of Split.
facts.excerpt: Awake to a delectable breakfast buffet at Spalatum Restaurant, with chic interiors or terrace views of the Adriatic Sea and the city of Split.

facts.text: Gooshter Beach Club serves street food with flavours from the East and South in an informal setting.
facts.excerpt: street food concept, with rich flavors from the East and South in an informal dining atmosphere.

facts.text: Gooshter Beach Club is open during the summer.
facts.excerpt: in an informal dining atmosphere. Open during summer.

facts.text: Port 74 focuses on sustainable, health-conscious cuisine with locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Port 74 focuses on sustainable, health-conscious cuisine, with locally sourced ingredients cultivated with passion and in sync with nature at this restaurant in Split.

facts.text: La Vue bar has pastel interiors with gold details and a large bar, communal table and lounge.
facts.excerpt: Contemporary design, featuring large bar, spacious communal table and inviting lounge space create a focal point of the resort. Interior exudes with pastel colours and gold like details, forming relaxed ambiance.

facts.text: The hotel has beachside cabanas along the shoreline.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in the ultimate seaside escape with our luxurious beachside cabanas.

facts.text: Split Airport is about 16 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: SPU is located approximately 16.0 Miles from the hotel.

facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Le Méridien Lav, Split do not have a fridge.
